Why the granularity choice changes the write path.
A chunked transaction binds the whole transaction to
prefix. Under hashing, the hash of
"th" and the hash of "the" land in different shards — so
begin_prefix_tx returns None for hash-based granularities and
the importer falls back to the per-record increment_cas path,
